inputRootSignature: theorem unbiasedness_and_mse_poisson_estimator {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (theta a : ℝ) (htheta : 0 < theta) (ha : 0 < a) (X : ℕ → Ω → ℕ) (hX_meas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (hX_indep : iIndepFun X P) (n : ℕ) (hn : a < (n : ℝ)) : let rate : NNReal := ⟨theta, htheta.le⟩ (∀ i, IdentDistrib (X i) id P (poissonMeasure rate)) → let S : Ω → ℕ := fun ω ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω let T : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦ (1 - a / (n : ℝ)) ^ S ω (∫ ω, T ω ∂P = Real.exp (-a * theta)) ∧ (∫ ω, (T ω - Real.exp (-a * theta)) ^ 2 ∂P) = Real.exp (-2 * a * theta) * (Real.exp (a ^ 2 * theta / (n : ℝ)) - 1)
